title: The spectral object of the vertical truncation tower
statement: Let C be abelian, with diagonal total complexes of all nonnegative double complexes. For each such K there is an EInt-indexed first-quadrant spectral object Y. For all integers a≤b and n≥0, H^n_Y(a,b) is isomorphic to H^n(Tot(W[a,b)(K))), where W is [def-sp-double-complex-vertical-window] applied columnwise. Also H^n_Y(bottom,top) is isomorphic to H^n(Tot(K)). This asserts neither page calculations nor convergence.

source.place: Proof steps 1 and 2, first sequence; spectral-object reformulation

proof.text: Regard the transpose of K extended by zero vertically as a bounded-below complex in the abelian category of nonnegative horizontal complexes. Exact horizontal evaluation identifies its canonical smart truncations with the columnwise truncations [def-sp-double-complex-vertical-window]. Totalize interval objects; use one-sided truncations for infinite endpoints and K for the whole interval.

Totalization on uniformly bounded-below complexes of horizontal complexes preserves cones and vertical quasi-isomorphisms. For the latter, an acyclic-column cone is acyclic on totals: eliminate the leftmost component of a total cycle using vertical exactness; subtract its total boundary and move to the next horizontal index. The vertical index decreases, so the uniform lower bound terminates this finite diagonal chase. This is equivalently a chase of kernels and images in the abelian category. Thus totalization descends to a triangulated functor on the bounded-below derived category. Apply the standard t-structure spectral object to K, then this functor and the homology functor. The natural connecting maps and exactness are provided by these constructions, and the interval comparisons are their object identifications.
Intervals ending at or below zero vanish. Intervals starting at a have no total terms below a. These imply the two first-quadrant vanishing conditions, also for extended endpoints.

lean.statement: theorem exists_verticalSpectralObject [∀ L : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ), L.HasTotal (ComplexShape.up ℕ)] (K : HomologicalComplex₂ C (ComplexShape.up ℕ) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)) : ∃ Y : CategoryTheory.Abelian.SpectralObject C EInt, Y.IsFirstQuadrant ∧ (∀ (a b : ℤ) (hab : a ≤ b) (n : ℕ), Nonempty ((Y.H n).obj (mk₁ (homOfLE (show (a : EInt) ≤ (b : EInt) from WithBotTop.coe_le_coe.mpr hab))) ≅ (HomologicalComplex₂.total (((verticalWindow a b).mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).obj K) (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology n)) ∧ (∀ n : ℕ, Nonempty ((Y.H n).obj (mk₁ (homOfLE (bot_le : (⊥ : EInt) ≤ ⊤))) ≅ (K.total (ComplexShape.up ℕ)).homology n))
